limitations: Only ordinary shortest-path distances on the once-subdivided binary hypercube; no fractional negative-type exponents or fixed-large-scale kernel classification are asserted. Originality evidence is bounded; independent review remains outstanding.
scientific_integrity: The theorem is proved by analytic Walsh block decomposition and sign counting. A separate finite checker verifies all dimension-1-through-6 cases but is not the universal proof. Earlier literature is acknowledged, and an equivalent historical statement cannot be categorically excluded.
title: Complete centered-distance spectrum and sharp negative-type transition for subdivided hypercubes
